composition_subtypes.role: Sort array to enable optimal interleaving for DP
DP to assign elements to residue classes minimizing cost

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array, then use 1D DP to assign elements to k residue classes minimizing sum of differences between elements k apart.
payload.rationale: Sorting is necessary because optimal arrangement is on sorted array; DP handles complex interleaving of residue class lengths.
